Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: The Plain of Glass
Cards.Text:
You do not lose Honor from Spider Clan and Fate cards you own.
You may use the rulebook Conquest ability twice per turn during the same battle.
Equipping Followers is a Battle/Limited ability for you.

Cards.Name: The New Foundries
Cards.Text:
Limited: Put a Spell from your hand face-up underneath this card.
Battle: Any number of times per turn, discard a Spell from under this card: Either straighten one to three Shugenja at the current battlefield if the Spell is Air or Water, or Ranged 4 Attack if it is Earth or Fire, or draw a card if it is Void.
